paper.title: Asymptotic analysis of the stochastic block model for modular networks and its algorithmic applications

headline: SBM detectability: 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; Q(0.10)=0.759, Q(0.50)=0.024, matched ER near zero

verdicts.gate: P1 deep-detectable recovery: mean overlap Q(eps=0.1)>=0.5 and matched ER control Q<=0.1
P2 deep-undetectable failure: mean overlap Q(eps=0.5)<=0.15 and within 0.05 of matched ER control
P3 monotone detectability sweep: Q(0.05)-Q(0.50)>=0.4, Q<=0.10 eps values >=0.5, Q(0.50)<=0.15

extra.scope: synthetic network-generation plus community-inference reproduction; detector receives adjacency only, not planted labels

citations: Decelle, A., Krzakala, F., Moore, C. & Zdeborova, L. (2011). Asymptotic analysis of the stochastic block model for modular networks and its algorithmic applications. Physical Review E 84:066106. doi:10.1103/PhysRevE.84.066106.

benchmark.note: matched Erdős-Rényi control at the same realized mean degree provides the no-community baseline
